name: agent-e2e-harness
description: Reusable E2E harness for agent-driven proof loops, MCP tooling, artifacts, and CI closure.
author: Aitor Roses

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @agent-e2e/harness && npm run typecheck --workspace @agent-e2e/harness && npm run typecheck --workspace @agent-e2e/showcase
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @agent-e2e/harness && npm run typecheck:public && npm run test --workspace @agent-e2e/harness && npm run test --workspace @agent-e2e/showcase
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run check:boundaries
